out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Second NDE: 'complete detachment from my body and detachment for what I had on earth.' First NDE: 'everything around me went black' then found self climbing ladder.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Second NDE: 'vast black and white circle that turned into a tunnel' with vacuum-like fast movement; diverted mid-tunnel to a hallway with doors. First NDE: climbing 'a long golden ladder up through the clouds.'
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Sounds: 'roaring freight train' with 'ding, ding, ding' and 'wind chimes ringing.' Sensation: 'The top pulled me back of my head going very fast.'

arrival.religious_figure_detail: First NDE: a man the experiencer identified as God: medium build, white shoulder-length hair, shiny white beard, white robe with sash; sat the child on his lap and conveyed immense love.
arrival.other_being_detail: Second NDE: dark room with other people 'mumbling' (unidentified).

environment.environment_other_detail: First NDE: clouds; marble bench; white marble rooms; huge screen; marble table with huge open book. Second NDE: long hallway with three large oak doors; pitch black darkness room.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: First NDE: 'went down very quickly' and found self in hospital room. Second NDE: 'pulled right back into my body.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Implied life purpose/mission: 'To me there is a mission why we are here.' First NDE return rationale: 'go back for her' (mother).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two events: (1) age 5 accidental ingestion of mother's medication leading to unconsciousness/hospitalization; (2) age 15 dental procedure with ether anesthesia for molar removal.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Second NDE includes praying to Jesus and saying the Our Father; first NDE identifies encountered man as God and references 'book of life' / judgment by works passage.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: First NDE includes ladder through clouds and 'book of life' checking name; second NDE includes hallway with three doors and entry into dark room with mumbling others.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Second NDE: tunnel leads to hallway/doors, then dark room, then light opening to view dentist room and return. First NDE: ladder ascent to God, then life-review screen (including prior life), then book scene and telepathic message to return, then rapid return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: First NDE includes explicit past-life imagery during life review (blond young man, wife/children, car accident) and a 'book of life' name-check scene. Second NDE includes being diverted mid-tunnel to a hallway with three oak doors and entering a pitch-black room with mumbling others.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was climbing up a long golden ladder up through the clouds"; "the most immense sense of love and understanding"; "pictures of my life were flashing very fast... they were of a previous life"; "He told me it was not my time and that I had to go back for her"; "I felt complete detachment from my body and detachment for what I had on earth"; "This experience was real and it has never left me."
